reason: Equivalent output. With a None result, n = 0 and forecast_free_heat(0, ...) returns []; with a result and a detector not suppressing, forecast_free_heat returns all zeros, because ExternalHeatDetector.update always runs _update_displacement after _update_activation and it zeroes state.free_heat_kw unless state.active or state.fading (exactly `suppressing`), as _reset does, and forecast_free_heat returns [0.0] * n while that rate is <= 0. detected_wood_slots finds no slot in all-zero kW, and forecast_kw has no other reader in build_wood_fuel_view. The guard stays: it keeps the view from depending on that invariant in external_heat.py. The BOOLOP mutant (`if result is not None or det.suppressing:`) differs from the original only when result is None and the detector suppresses (n = 0, so []), or when there is a result and the detector does not suppress (all zeros, as above). Its earlier killed_by tests/features.py pin (mutation-autofix, abe5cdcf3) came from the same SimpleNamespace stub with no forecast_free_heat. With the real detector in that probe the mutant survives tests/features.py (ALL 4636 PASSED), tests/guard_pins.py (61/61) and tests/wood_advisor.py (32/32), so the pin is replaced by this verdict.
